## Public API (the UI agent imports exactly these names — do not rename)

File src/lib/csv.ts:

export type CsvSheet = { headers: string[]; rows: string[][] };

export type MissingCell = { row: number; col: number };

export type DuplicateGroup = {
  key: string;
  indexes: number[]; // every row index in the group, ascending; index 0 of this array is the keeper
  label: string; // short human label from the first kept row
};

export type Analysis = {
  duplicateRowIndexes: number[]; // extra copies only, not the first occurrence
  duplicateGroups: DuplicateGroup[]; // only groups with 2+ rows
  missingCells: MissingCell[];
  rowsWithMissing: number[];
  missingByColumn: { header: string; index: number; count: number }[];
};

export function parseCsv(text: string): CsvSheet;
export function analyze(sheet: CsvSheet): Analysis;
export function removeDuplicateRows(rows: string[][]): string[][];
export function removeIncompleteRows(rows: string[][], width: number): string[][];
export function applyClean(rows: string[][], width: number, mode: "all" | "duplicates" | "incomplete"): { rows: string[][]; removedDuplicates: number; removedIncomplete: number };
export function toCsv(headers: string[], rows: string[][]): string;
export function downloadCsv(filename: string, csv: string): void;
export function cleanDownloadName(name: string): string;

Rules:
- parseCsv: strip UTF-8 BOM, accept CRLF and LF. RFC 4180 quotes: commas inside quotes, doubled quotes as escape, newlines inside quotes. A trailing newline must not create an extra empty record. Do NOT drop data rows that are entirely blank — those are missing-value issues. If the file has no records, throw Error "This file has no rows." If the header row is empty or every header cell is blank, throw Error "This file has no header row." Trim header cells. Pad or trim each data row to header width. Keep cell text as parsed (do not trim stored values; trimming is only for comparison).
- Duplicate: two rows match when every cell is equal after trim, across header width. Keep the first occurrence. duplicateRowIndexes lists only later copies. duplicateGroups lists each group with count >= 2. label: join the first two non-empty trimmed cells of the keeper with " · ", max ~48 chars; if all empty, "Empty row".
- Missing: a cell is missing when trim() === "". rowsWithMissing is sorted unique row indexes. missingByColumn covers every header, count 0 included.
- removeDuplicateRows keeps first of each trimmed key. removeIncompleteRows drops a row if any cell within width is missing. applyClean: mode "incomplete" only drops incomplete; mode "duplicates" only drops dupes; mode "all" drops incomplete FIRST, then duplicates among what remains. Counts are how many rows each step actually removed (not the pre-clean analysis counts).
- toCsv: quote a field if it contains comma, quote, CR, or LF; double internal quotes. Join rows with \r\n and end with \r\n.
- downloadCsv: browser download via Blob text/csv;charset=utf-8, anchor click, revoke URL. Guard if document is undefined.
- cleanDownloadName: "harbor-orders.csv" -> "harbor-orders-clean.csv"; strip the last extension; if no extension, append "-clean.csv".

## Sample src/lib/sample.ts

Print "csv.check ok" on success.

Duplicate row indexes are sorted ascending. The UI agent must create index.css because main.tsx imports it. App.tsx must be a default export.

Row indexes are 0-based into the internal sheet array, not file line numbers. In applyClean mode "all", incomplete rows are removed before duplicates; if two incomplete rows are duplicates of each other, both count as removedIncomplete and removedDuplicates stays zero for that pair. Duplicate groups use a JSON.stringify key of trimmed cells, with a human-readable label built from the first two non-empty trimmed cells joined by a middle dot and truncated to 48 characters. All-empty keepers display as "Empty row".

Whitespace-only cells are treated as missing. Values are trimmed only during duplicate and missing checks; display labels preserve original whitespace.

CSV export uses CRLF line endings with a trailing CRLF. parseCsv normalizes newlines and quoting, so round-trip values may differ from the original bytes.

cleanDownloadName strips only the final extension and appends -clean.csv. Names without extensions, including leading-dot files like .gitignore, receive the suffix.

downloadCsv exits silently when document is undefined.

downloadCsv creates a temporary text/csv blob and clicks a hidden anchor to trigger the download. parseCsv throws exact errors when a file has no rows or no header row. Blank data rows are preserved as missing cells. removeDuplicateRows keys duplicate groups by the longest row in each set. applyClean and analyze use the header width passed as headers.length. The returned cleaned rows are shallow copies; the original inputs remain unmutated. The sample CSV contains 18 data rows.

The UI can import `../lib/csv` with or without the `.ts` extension. Extra cells beyond the header width are ignored during duplicate detection but preserved on the surviving row; pass `sheet.headers.length` to avoid this. Trimmed values like `"Mug"` and `" Mug "` match as duplicates, yet the kept row keeps its original spacing.

missingByColumn is aligned with the header array and includes a zero count for every column. This lets the UI render missing indicators for all columns without omitting empty ones.

## Exported API

From `src/lib/csv.ts`:

- Types: `CsvSheet`, `MissingCell`, `DuplicateGroup`, `Analysis`
- Functions: `parseCsv`, `analyze`, `removeDuplicateRows`, `removeIncompleteRows`, `applyClean`, `toCsv`, `downloadCsv`, `cleanDownloadName`

From `src/lib/sample.ts`: `SAMPLE_NAME` (`"harbor-orders.csv"`) and `SAMPLE_CSV`.

## For the UI

`src/main.tsx` already imports `./index.css` and a **default export** `App` from `./App`. Dev server port is **5173**. Fraunces, Outfit, and IBM Plex Mono are loaded in `index.html`.

Row indexes in `Analysis` are **0-based data rows**. The header is not row 0. `duplicateRowIndexes` lists extra copies only. `duplicateGroups[].indexes[0]` is the keeper. Show `label` to people; `key` is `JSON.stringify` of the trimmed cells. Labels join the keeper’s first two non-empty trimmed cells with ` · `, cap at 48 characters, and use `"Empty row"` when every cell is blank.

Cells are stored raw. A cell is missing when `trim() === ""`, including whitespace-only cells. `missingByColumn` includes every header, with `count: 0` where nothing is missing.

Pass `headers.length` as the width to `applyClean` and `removeIncompleteRows`. Mode `"all"` drops incomplete rows first, then duplicates among what remains. `removedIncomplete` and `removedDuplicates` are how many rows each step actually removed. An incomplete pair therefore counts only as incomplete in mode `"all"`.

`parseCsv` throws `Error` with `"This file has no rows."` or `"This file has no header row."` Blank data rows are kept. `toCsv` writes CRLF and ends with CRLF. `downloadCsv(cleanDownloadName(name), csv)` performs the browser download and does nothing when `document` is undefined. `cleanDownloadName("harbor-orders.csv")` is `"harbor-orders-clean.csv"`; a name with no extension gets `"-clean.csv"` appended.
